entryText: Six quick questions to notice what makes you feel loved.
exerciseSubtitle: Six quick questions, just for you.
questions: What makes you feel loved the most?
On a hard day, what comforts you the most?
What do you notice first when your partner shows care?
Which of these gestures warms your heart?
What makes you feel important to someone?
If you could choose one gesture for today, what would it be?

options1(map).acts: Seeing the person help me with something.
options1(map).gifts: Getting a small gift for no reason.

options2(map).time: Having someone nearby, with no rush to fix it.
options2(map).words: A message saying I'm on their mind.
options2(map).acts: Someone taking a task off my hands.
options2(map).gifts: A small care that arrived by surprise.

options3(map).time: When the person puts the phone down to be with me.
options3(map).words: When the person praises something I did.
options3(map).acts: When the person notices what I need and does it.
options3(map).gifts: When the person remembers something I like.
options3(map).touch: When the person touches me lightly as they pass.

options4(map).time: A quiet date, just the two of us.
options4(map).words: A conversation where I feel heard.
options4(map).acts: A small help with a task.
options4(map).gifts: A simple gift that has to do with me.
options4(map).touch: A caress on my hair or hand.

options5(map).time: When someone chooses to spend time with me.
options5(map).words: When someone acknowledges what I do.
options5(map).acts: When someone makes my day easier.
options5(map).gifts: When someone remembers me with a detail.
options5(map).touch: When someone hugs me without needing to speak.

options6(map).time: Saving a free evening for us.

resultSubtitle: A description of what makes you feel loved, in your own way.

descriptions(map).time: You feel loved when you have real time with someone you care about: unhurried, no screens, just presence.
descriptions(map).words: You feel loved when you hear, honestly, what the other person feels for you.
descriptions(map).acts: You feel loved when someone notices what you need and helps without being asked.
descriptions(map).gifts: You feel loved when someone remembers you in a small detail, chosen with care.
descriptions(map).touch: You feel loved when a hug, a held hand or a caress says what words cannot.
